name: Thrombocytopenia

category.name: General Systemic
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: Submit the following to the FAA for review: Current status report from the treating Hematologist with diagnosis, treatment plan and prognosis; If an underlying cause is identified, the status report should include diagnosis, treatment plan, prognosis, and adherence to treatment for this condition; List of medications and side effects, if any; Operative notes and discharge summary (if applicable); Copies of imaging reports or other lab (if already performed by treating hematologist); and CBC within the past 90 days.

rows.label: A
rows.condition: 5 or more years ago Most recent event/diagnosis
rows.condition_html: A. 5 or more years ago Most recent event/diagnosis
rows.evaluation_data: No symptoms or current problems. No ongoing treatment OR surveillance needed.
rows.evaluation_data_html: No symptoms or current problems. No ongoing treatment OR surveillance needed.
rows.disposition: ISSUE Summarize this history in Block 60.

rows.label: B
rows.condition: Less than 5 years ago Due to: Drugs (including HIT*), Infection (now resolved), Pregnancy, etc. *Heparin induced thrombocytopenia
rows.condition_html:
B. Less than 5 years ago Due to: Drugs (including HIT*), Infection (now resolved), Pregnancy, etc.

*Heparin induced thrombocytopenia
rows.evaluation_data: • Treating physician report verifies condition has resolved or, if due to a medication, it has been stopped with no plan to re-start. • No symptoms or current problems. • No ongoing treatment OR surveillance needed. Note: If an underlying condition is identified, see that section. Example: Thrombocytopenia due to chemotherapy, malignancy, autoimmune disorders, or alcohol use.

rows.label: C
rows.condition: Less than 5 years ago Immune thrombocytopenia (ITP)
rows.evaluation_data: See CACI worksheet Note: CACI is for Chronic ITP only. All other causes of thrombocytopenia, See item “D. All Others” below.
